title: Second Trip into the Dragon Nest
summary: With the ancient creatures off hunting the holy lords, Ye Fan, Ji Ziyue, Hei Huang and the Holy Monkey go deeper into the collapsing Dragon Nest. Ji Ziyue scolds Ye Fan for hiding that his wounds are healed. Beside a human coffin, a True Dragon Immortal Medicine traps Ye Fan's consciousness in an illusion of his parents on Earth, until he breaks free. An ancient youth wakes his kin, but Hei Huang, speaking the ancient language and showing an Ancient Emperor token, poses as a descendant of the Undying Emperor, and the youth guides them. They pass four coffins that seem to belong to a single human Great Emperor who lived through four eras; a star-marked object leaps into the Mother of All Things Cauldron and can only be opened at Immortal Platform. They find Dongfang Taiyi, an ancient human Saint chained for massacres caused by merging the True Sun and True Moon Scriptures. They escape with the Immortal Medicine's pure blood collected in the cauldron through Hei Huang's formation, and Nannan shows off an 'outer-space' artifact a man in black left her.
